messages:
anika: quick check — finalizing postmortem actions from INC-834. can owners confirm or reassign? aiming to close the list by next Wed. summary below:

```
INC-834 action items:
- A: upload debug logs to S3 (owner: leo) due: 2024-07-10
- B: update canary policy and rollout plan (owner: maya) due: 2024-07-12
- C: add regression test and CI gating (owner: unassigned) due: 2024-07-08
- D: docs + runbook (owner: jon) due: 2024-07-11
```

please reply with: "ack", "reassign -> @NAME", or a new due date. 

anika: also flagging any cross-team deps (eng-infra / qa / security) here so we can unblock early.

leo: ack — I will upload the logs today. moving due to 2024-07-09 (earlier) since it's quick.

maya: I can take B but note release freeze next week. realistic finish is 2024-07-14. can we relax priority or get an extra headcount?

jon: ack for D. draft in Google drive: https://g.drive/redwood/inc834-runbook. aiming 2024-07-10 now.

sam: I can pick up C. need infra access and a test VM from eng-infra. tagging infra here: @eng-infra-bot can you confirm ETA?

eng-infra-bot: @sam — scheduled slot for test VM creation on 2024-07-05. will post creds to #eng-infra when ready.

sarah: from PM side — B is important for canary safety but can tolerate 1–2 day slip. prefer 2024-07-12 if possible.

anika: thanks. decision proposal: keep B -> maya with target 2024-07-12, mark medium priority. sam gets C, infra to provide VM 7/05; leo moves A to 7/09; jon D -> 7/10. sound good?

maya: sounds ok given the freeze. I’ll try to finish 7/12, ping if I need help.

leo: done — uploaded logs, S3 link: s3://redwood-inc/834/logs.zip. marking A as complete.

sam: ack, will open PR for test harness today (PR #452).

jon: updated runbook with steps for rollback and rollback smoke test.

anika: listing updated in tracker and RT: https://tracker/redwood/incidents/834/actions — will follow up in 48h for final close. if anyone reassigns, please do so now. :thumbsup:

maya: acked. if anything blocks, I’ll loop in eng-runtime for canary config help.

anika: thanks everyone — closing the async check. if no objections by 3300001210, I’ll mark this thread resolved and move items to "closed-pending-verification".

leo: 👍

jon: 👍

sam: ✅

eng-infra-bot: VM created and credentials posted to #eng-infra at 2024-07-05 09:12 UTC.
